```{r}
#Merge odd household regions to areas matched with GADM regions

df.MICS_HH <- df.MICS_HH %>%
  mutate(
    HH7_region = case_when(
      country == "Samoa" & HH7_region %in% c("Apia Urban Area", "North West Upolu", "Rest of Upolu") ~ "UPOLU",
      country == "Samoa" & HH7_region == "Savaii" ~ "SAVAII",
      country == "Togo" & HH7_region %in% c("Golfe Urbain", "Lomé Commune") ~ "Lomé Commune/Golfe Urbain",
      country %in% c("Sao Tome and Principe", "São Tomé and Príncipe") &
        HH7_region %in% c("DISTRITO DE MÉ-ZÓCHI", "DISTRITO DE ÁGUA GRANDE") ~ "São Tomé",
      TRUE ~ HH7_region
    )
  )

df.MICS_HH %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_HH7_region = n_distinct(HH7_region, na.rm = TRUE),
    HH7_regions = paste(unique(na.omit(HH7_region)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 1.3 Creating E.coli indicator variable
```{r}

df.MICS_Ecoli <- createDataFrameWithEcoliIndicator(df.MICS_HH)

df.MICS_Ecoli <- renameDuplicateHH7RegionNamesFromDifferentCountries(df.MICS_Ecoli)

EcoliFreeRegionalProportion <-createIndicatorForRegionalProportionFreeOfEcoli(df.MICS_Ecoli)

EcoliFreeRegionalProportion <- EcoliFreeRegionalProportion %>%
   dplyr::mutate(
    HH5Y_clean = case_when(
      country.x == "Nepal" & HH5Y.x == 2082 ~ 2024L,
      country.x == "Pakistan Khyber Pakhtunkhwa" & HH5Y.x == 2019 ~ 2018L,
      country.x == "Pakistan Khyber Pakhtunkhwa" & HH5Y.x == 2018 ~ 2017L,
      country.x == "Pakistan Balochistan" & HH5Y.x == 2019 ~ 2018L,
      country.x == "Pakistan Punjab" & HH5Y.x == 2017 ~ 2018L,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(HH5Y.x)
    )
  ) %>%
   dplyr::group_by(country.x) %>%
   dplyr::mutate(
    analysis_year = min(HH5Y_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
   dplyr::ungroup() %>%
   dplyr::select(-HH5Y_clean)


```

```{r}

  distinct(country, analysis_year, source, HH7_region) %>%
```

```{r}

# Build lookup using both World Bank Country and GADM_NAME_0
wb_lookup_base <- bind_rows(
  country_name_key_WB %>%
    transmute(
      country_alias = Country,
      country_wb = Country
    ),
  country_name_key_WB %>%
    transmute(
      country_alias = GADM_NAME_0,
      country_wb = Country
    )
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country_alias), !is.na(country_wb)) %>%
  mutate(country_alias_key = clean_key(country_alias)) %>%
  distinct(country_alias_key, country_wb)

# Add manual aliases found in both datasets
wb_lookup_manual <- tribble(
  ~country_alias,                          ~country_wb,
  "DR Congo",                              "Congo, Dem. Rep.",
  "Democratic Republic of the Congo",      "Congo, Dem. Rep.",
  "Lao People's Democratic Republic",      "Lao PDR",
  "Laos",                                  "Lao PDR",
  "Palestina",                             "West Bank and Gaza",
  "Vietnam",                               "Viet Nam",
  "Gambia",                                "Gambia, The",
  "Pakistan Balochistan",                  "Pakistan",
  "Pakistan Khyber Pakhtunkhwa",           "Pakistan",
  "Pakistan Punjab",                       "Pakistan",
  "Guyana",                                "Guyana"
) %>%
  mutate(country_alias_key = clean_key(country_alias)) %>%
  select(country_alias_key, country_wb)

wb_lookup <- bind_rows(wb_lookup_base, wb_lookup_manual) %>%
  distinct(country_alias_key, .keep_all = TRUE)
wb_lookup
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 2. Prepare covariate and outcome region tables
# -----------------------------

cov_regions <- join_names_covariates %>%
  transmute(
    country_cov = country,
    HH7_region_cov = HH7_region,
    country_alias_key = clean_key(country)
  ) %>%
  left_join(wb_lookup, by = "country_alias_key") %>%
  mutate(
    region_key = normalise_region_key(HH7_region_cov, country_wb)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

out_regions <- join_names_outcome %>%
  transmute(
    country_outcome = country,
    HH7_region_outcome = HH7_region,
    country_alias_key = clean_key(country)
  ) %>%
  left_join(wb_lookup, by = "country_alias_key") %>%
  mutate(
    region_key = normalise_region_key(HH7_region_outcome, country_wb)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Countries that did not map to a World Bank name
cov_countries_not_mapped <- cov_regions %>%
  filter(is.na(country_wb)) %>%
  distinct(country_cov) %>%
  arrange(country_cov)

outcome_countries_not_mapped <- out_regions %>%
  filter(is.na(country_wb)) %>%
  distinct(country_outcome) %>%
  arrange(country_outcome)

cov_countries_not_mapped
outcome_countries_not_mapped
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 3. Exact region matches by WB country + cleaned region
# -----------------------------

exact_crosswalk <- out_regions %>%
  filter(!is.na(country_wb)) %>%
  inner_join(
    cov_regions %>% filter(!is.na(country_wb)),
    by = c("country_wb", "region_key"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    country_wb,
    country_outcome,
    HH7_region_outcome,
    country_cov,
    HH7_region_cov,
    dist = 0,
    match_type = "exact"
  ) %>%
  distinct()

unmatched_after_exact <- out_regions %>%
  filter(!is.na(country_wb)) %>%
  anti_join(
    exact_crosswalk %>%
      distinct(country_outcome, HH7_region_outcome),
    by = c("country_outcome", "HH7_region_outcome")
  )
```

```{r}
fuzzy_crosswalk <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(unmatched_after_exact$country_wb)), function(cty) {
  
  out_cty <- unmatched_after_exact %>%
    dplyr::filter(country_wb == cty)
  
  cov_cty <- cov_regions %>%
    dplyr::filter(country_wb == cty) %>%
    dplyr::select(country_cov, HH7_region_cov, region_key)
  
  if (nrow(cov_cty) == 0) {
    return(
      out_cty %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          country_wb,
          country_outcome,
          HH7_region_outcome,
          country_cov = NA_character_,
          HH7_region_cov = NA_character_,
          dist = NA_real_,
          match_type = "no_covariate_country_match",
          n_best_candidates = NA_integer_
        )
    )
  }
  
  fuzzyjoin::stringdist_left_join(
    out_cty,
    cov_cty,
    by = "region_key",
    method = "jw",
    max_dist = 0.45,
    distance_col = "dist"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dist_order = dplyr::if_else(is.na(dist), Inf, dist)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(country_wb, country_outcome, HH7_region_outcome) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(dist_order, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_best_candidates = dplyr::n()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      match_type = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(HH7_region_cov) ~ "no_region_candidate_within_threshold",
        dist <= 0.10 ~ "strong_fuzzy",
        dist <= 0.20 ~ "review_fuzzy",
        TRUE ~ "weak_fuzzy"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      country_wb,
      country_outcome,
      HH7_region_outcome,
      country_cov,
      HH7_region_cov,
      dist,
      match_type,
      n_best_candidates
    )
})
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 5. Final region crosswalk
# -----------------------------

region_crosswalk <- bind_rows(
  exact_crosswalk %>%
    mutate(n_best_candidates = 1L),
  fuzzy_crosswalk
) %>%
  arrange(country_wb, country_outcome, HH7_region_outcome, dist)

region_crosswalk

# -----------------------------
# 6. Review non-exact matches
# -----------------------------

regions_to_review <- region_crosswalk %>%
  filter(match_type != "exact") %>%
  arrange(country_wb, match_type, desc(is.na(dist)), dist)

regions_to_review

write_csv(region_crosswalk, "region_crosswalk_with_WB_country_names.csv")
#write_csv(regions_to_review, "region_crosswalk_review_needed.csv")
```

```{r}
manual_crosswalk <- manual_region_fixes %>%
  left_join(
    cov_lookup_for_manual_fixes,
    by = c(
      "country_cov_key",
      "correct_region_key" = "cov_region_key"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    out_lookup_for_manual_fixes,
    by = c(
      "country_wb",
      "outcome_region_key"
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    country_wb,
    country_outcome,
    HH7_region_outcome = coalesce(HH7_region_outcome.y, HH7_region_outcome.x),
    country_cov = coalesce(country_cov.y, country_cov.x),
    HH7_region_cov,
    dist = 0,
    match_type = "manual_override",
    n_best_candidates = 1L
  )
```

```{r}
# Join with income group and UN region data

  dplyr::mutate(

  ) %>%

    df.water_quality_overview %>%

        Country = stringr::str_squish(Country),

set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
# Prepare keys

un_key_clean <- UN_region_key %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Code = `ISO-alpha3 Code`,
    un_region = `Region Name`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()


# 2. Training region distribution


training_regions <- EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_with_covariates_enriched %>%
  dplyr::distinct(country_cov, HH7_region_cov) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    country_cov_join = dplyr::case_when(
      country_cov == "Gambia" ~ "Gambia, The",
      country_cov == "Democratic Republic of the Congo" ~ "Congo, Dem. Rep.",
      country_cov == "Lao People's Democratic Republic" ~ "Lao PDR",
      country_cov == "Palestina" ~ "West Bank and Gaza",
      country_cov == "São Tomé and Príncipe" ~ "Sao Tome and Principe",
      country_cov == "Vietnam" ~ "Viet Nam",
      TRUE ~ country_cov
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    country_name_key_WB,
    by = c("country_cov_join" = "Country")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Code = dplyr::if_else(country_cov == "Guyana" & is.na(Code), "GUY", Code),
    IncomeGroup2024 = dplyr::if_else(country_cov == "Guyana" & is.na(IncomeGroup2024), "UM", IncomeGroup2024)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    un_key_clean,
    by = "Code"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    un_region = dplyr::if_else(Code == "XKX" & is.na(un_region), "Europe", un_region),
    dataset = "Training",
    income_group = dplyr::recode(
      IncomeGroup2024,
      "L"  = "Low income",
      "LM" = "Lower middle income",
      "UM" = "Upper middle income"
    )
  )

lost_training_regions <- training_regions %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(income_group) | is.na(un_region)) %>%
  dplyr::select(country_cov, HH7_region_cov, Code, IncomeGroup2024, income_group, un_region)

training_regions <- training_regions %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(income_group), !is.na(un_region))

lost_training_regions
```

```{r}
# 3. Prediction region distribution


prediction_regions <- df.prediction_nonpop %>%
  dplyr::distinct(NAME_0, NAME_1, GID_0, GID_1) %>%

    country_name_key_WB,
```

```{r}
# 4. Combine

region_distribution <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  training_regions %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      dataset,
      country = country_cov,
      region = HH7_region_cov,
      income_group,
      un_region
    ),
  
  prediction_regions %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      dataset,
      country = Country,
      region = NAME_1,
      income_group,
      un_region
    )
)

# 5. Proportion by income group


income_compare <- region_distribution %>%
  dplyr::distinct(dataset, country, region, income_group) %>%
  dplyr::count(dataset, income_group, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(dataset) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggplot(income_compare,
       aes(x = income_group, y = prop, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Income group",
    y = "Proportion of regions",
    fill = "Dataset",
    title = "Distribution of regions across LMIC income groups: training vs prediction"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
df.MICS_Ecoli_design <- createDataFrameWithEcoliIndicator_design(df.MICS_HH)

df.MICS_Ecoli_design <- renameDuplicateHH7RegionNamesFromDifferentCountries(
  df.MICS_Ecoli_design
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Create binary outcome and person-weighted survey weight
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df.MICS_Ecoli_design <- df.MICS_Ecoli_design %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    no_ecoli = as.integer(WQ27_sourcewaterBIN == "0" | WQ27_sourcewaterBIN == 0),
    HH48_wqsweight = as.numeric(HH48) * as.numeric(wqsweight)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#. Define survey design
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecoli_design <- survey::svydesign(
  id = ~HH1,
  strata = ~HH6,
  weights = ~HH48_wqsweight,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = df.MICS_Ecoli_design
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Estimate regional E. coli-free proportion with SE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE <- survey::svyby(
  ~no_ecoli,
  ~country + HH7_region,
  design = ecoli_design,
  FUN = survey::svymean,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  vartype = c("se", "ci")
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel = no_ecoli,
    No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_se = se,
    No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_ci_l = ci_l,
    No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_ci_u = ci_u
  )

EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE
```

```{r}
EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE <- EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    df.MICS_Ecoli_design %>%
      dplyr::group_by(country, HH7_region) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        HouseholdsInRegion.Freq.x = dplyr::n(),
        HH5Y.x = min(HH5Y, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("country", "HH7_region")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    country.x = country
  )

EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE
```

```{r}

# Create candidate RF weights
EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE <- EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ci_width = No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_ci_u - No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_ci_l,
    
    precision_weight_raw = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_se) & No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_se > 0,
      1 / (No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_se^2),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    precision_weight_capped = pmin(
      precision_weight_raw,
      quantile(precision_weight_raw, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    
    precision_weight_scaled = precision_weight_capped / mean(precision_weight_capped, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Plot distributions
weight_distribution_plot <- EcoliFreeRegionalProportion_SE %>%
  dplyr::select(
    HouseholdsInRegion.Freq.x,
    No_EcoliAtRegionalLevel_se,
    ci_width,
    precision_weight_scaled
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), value > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Value",
    y = "Number of regions",
    title = "Distribution of candidate weighting metrics"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

weight_distribution_plot
```
